red_line_review: Synthetic actor-channel records exercise causal surfaces only and are not actor output or evidence of judgment.
The durable practice is an actor-channel extensional relation grounded in raw receipts, not a controller-selected winner, supplied diagnosis, or self-report.
Locator derivation losslessly retains the complete source context and hashes the complete post-trial surface without selecting future-relevant rows.
Wrong but valid practices and mechanisms remain protocol-valid until independent consequence; the controller cannot use quality to rescue them.
Scored rows are fresh opaque structural replicas and no scored row identity occurs in projected history.
